ammonia.reason: Long 8-12 mo proteolysis and deamination yields low NH3, uncooked pressed interior with no washed rind.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasture cow milk with p-cresol/indole traces and 600-800 mg/kg propionate from Propionibacterium/rumen carryover.

bitter.reason: Accumulated hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin plus 2.34% NaCl enhances bitter taste in aged paste.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation, methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone only trace relative abundance.

browning.reason: Maillard between proteolysis-derived amino acids and residual galactose on heating in aged low-moisture paste.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin not detected in ripened Cantal by GC-MS; citrate metabolism by Lactococcus exhausted by 95-130 d.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: High free butanoic 63.4 mg/kg plus hexanoic 18.1 mg/kg and methylbutanoic 6.5 mg/kg from lipolysis and Leu/Ile catabolism.

creaminess.reason: 29.3% fat, 47% FDM gives mouth-coating fat, limited by firm 62% DM aged matrix and pH 5.5.

crumbliness.reason: Milled tomme grains salted and pressed, 37.9% moisture and pH 5.5 cause granular fracture.

firmness.reason: High dry matter 62.1% and Ca-phosphate crosslinked uncooked pressed curd aged 9 mo.

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylethanol floral by GC-O from Phe catabolism by lactococci/yeasts, no quantified phenylacetaldehyde.

fruity.reason: Low ethyl butanoate 19 ug/kg and ethyl hexanoate 45 ug/kg from esterase esterification of FFA with ethanol.

goaty.reason: Cow milk only, no caprine 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal 62 ug/kg at 95 d from Leu Strecker degradation, increasing with proteolysis to nutty/malty notes.

melt.reason: pH 5.5 intact casein with 29% fat flows moderately, uncooked but not acid-set non-melter.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one mushroom GC-O from linoleate oxidation and natural rind flora.

oil_off.reason: Moderate fat 29% with only ~0.6% as free FFA (1.75 g/kg) gives limited free oil on melting.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol reported.

sour_vinegar.reason: Very high acetic 1262 mg/kg from heterofermentative lactate/ citrate metabolism plus lactic acid pH 5.5.

stretch.reason: Rennet-coagulated, milled and pressed, no hot-water pasta-filata alignment.

sulfur_cooked.reason: No sulfur odors by GC-O, only trace dimethyl disulfide; no cooked-curd H2S/methional accumulation.

sweet.reason: Residual lactate 16 g/kg and propionate plus fat masking of acidity perceived as mild milky sweet.

umami.reason: Extensive 8-12 mo proteolysis WSN/TN rise releases glutamate and savory peptides.
